## Overview

ThermoSense (SPIE) is a proceedings-based conference series on thermal infrared applications and thermography. Topics commonly include IR measurement practices, calibration, data analysis methods, and application-driven studies, where emissivity treatment may be discussed as part of quantitative IR workflows.
